info.name: Pathway Analysis Service database query API
More information on an entry in Reactome knowledgebase

params.name: id
params.description: DbId or StId of the requested database object

params.name: fetchIncomingRelationships
params.description: Whether incoming relationships should be fetched

params.name: summariseReferenceEntity
params.description: Whether ReferenceEntity should be summarising its physical entities

params.name: includeDisease
params.description: Whether disease specific data should be fetched

params.name: view
params.description: Global parameter - Customise the view to be more concise and/or aggregate relationships

params.name: includeRef
params.description: Global parameter - If true, replace element ref to dbId by standard JSOG object {@ref}

items.docs: Based on the given identifier, i.e. stable id or database id, this method queries for an entry in Reactome knowledgebase providing more information. In particular, the retrieved database object has all its properties and direct relationships (relationships of depth 1) filled, while it also includes any second level relationships regarding regulations and catalysts.

items.docs: This method queries for a set of entries in Reactome knowledgebase based on the given list of identifiers. The provided list of identifiers can include stable ids, database ids or a mixture of both. It should be underlined that any duplicated ids are eliminated while only requests containing up to 20 ids are processed.
